prompts.prompt: Paint one powerful fantasy MMORPG skill icon. Art direction: classic early-2000s Korean PC RPG spell illustrations, hand-painted fantasy, confident brushwork, sculpted light-and-shadow shapes, rich jewel colors, deep near-black negative space, brilliant but restrained highlights. The reference strip is ONLY a guide to the game's palette and old-school painted visual language. Those references are tiny icons enlarged for inspection: DO NOT imitate their enlarged pixels. Paint at natural high resolution with refined edges and brush shading. Absolutely NO visible square pixel grid, mosaic, voxel blocks, nearest-neighbor enlargement or flat vector graphics. A compelling cohesive action composition designed to read as a small game icon, not a collection of pasted objects. Preserve the family resemblance through colors and material shading while giving this advanced skill its own silhouette. Square full-bleed composition, a very thin plain antique-gold border, no text, digits, labels, badges, UI mockup or surrounding margin. Dark shadows must separate the main shapes; avoid filling everything with glow. HEAVEN PENETRATION. Three forceful celestial arrow lances, formed from silver-blue steel and concentrated cyan-white magic, pierce diagonally downward into one bright area-impact point. Compose them in an elegant staggered fan, with a dominant central lance and two supporting lances, long tapered energy trails sweeping up-right. Broad razor-sharp arrowheads, crisp steel facets, luminous cores, convincing perspective and a small violent impact bloom. The mood is an ascended piercing archery technique. Deep purple and midnight-blue backdrop echoing the game's Penetration family, white/silver and icy cyan focal light. Aim for gorgeous restrained painted fantasy icon art, strong velocity and precision. No hands, character, angel, wings, decorative runes or generic lightning bolt shapes.
